chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from Zurārah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام would not perform any prayer from the night, after he had prayed al-'atamah, until the middle of the night; and he would not perform any prayer from the day until the sun had passed the zenith.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful

ai.seo_question: When did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام perform the night and daytime nawafil prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding the timing of supererogatory prayers. It indicates that he would refrain from praying voluntary night prayers after the 'Isha prayer until midnight, and from voluntary daytime prayers until after the sun passed the zenith, making it relevant to the fiqh of prayer times.
